messages:
Ibrahim: Proposal: run an escrowed-lease probe to validate cross-region commit semantics for active-active. Not a full failover test we issue escrow tokens in resident region and verify reconciliation without committing to primary storage. Low blast, observational. Thoughts?

Tess: Interesting. Escrow tokens could let us validate "would-be" commits without changing canonical state. Agree low blast. We should ensure tokens are KMS-wrapped and short-lived.

Harper: Agree on KMS. Also we need a deterministic nonce/idempotency scheme so a replay won't accidentally commit later. Escrow tokens must be single-use & revocable.

Dmitri: Ops constraints: resident path will issue token and respond 202 + escrow_id. Primary path remains unchanged. We'll run a separate reconciler job that tries to apply escrowed ops to a sandbox DB with strict no-side-effect guard.

Ibrahim: Rollout sketch: 1) proxy rule `lease-escrow-probe-v1` routes 99% normal, 1% to escrow endpoint in resident region. 2) resident returns escrow token encrypted with region-KMS and signature. 3) async reconciler compares token->intent vs primary outcome. 4) emit mismatch metrics and sample traces.

Tess: Telemetry requirements: escrow_issued_count, escrow_reconcile_mismatch_rate, escrow_latency_p95, escrow_token_decrypt_failures. Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.02% for 15m.

Harper: We must be careful with KV cache: escrow path must always bypass prefix cache. Otherwise token issuance won't reflect real routing. Emit kv.cache_bypass{policy=lease-escrow-v1}.

Dmitri: Sample proxy snippet (pseudo):
```yaml
- id: lease-escrow-probe-v1
  match: tenant_id =~ "t-7.*"
  split:
    - weight: 99
      route: primary
    - weight: 1
      route: resident-escrow
  headers:
    - set: X-Policy: lease-escrow-probe-v1
    - set: X-Escrow-Mode: audit
```

Ibrahim: Escrow token format idea: base64(KMS_ENC_JSON) where inner JSON = {intent_hash, tenant, nonce, expiry, region, signature}. Reconciler will decrypt with region KMS and verify signature.

Tess: For privacy: consent-bot should validate X-Consent-Token before any escrow is issued for EU tenants. If missing or invalid, resident path returns 403 and we record `escrow_noncompliant_count`.

consent-bot: Confirmed. Any escrow request for EU tenants requires X-Consent-Token and consent_verifier header. Noncompliant requests will be logged and excluded from metrics.

Harper: Reconciler details: run async, compare intent_hash -> primary response digest (normalized token set). Use comparator tolerant to nondeterminism (ignore timestamps/IDs). Emit comparator_score per escrow. Flag if comparator_score > 0.015.

Dmitri: Rollback/stop criteria: if escrow_reconcile_mismatch_rate > 0.02% for 20m OR escrow_token_decrypt_failures > 0.05% trip circuit and disable escrow routing. Primary rollback owner: Dmitri, secondary: Harper.

Ibrahim: Also add a safety: escrow tokens auto-expire in 90s. If reconciler tries to attach later, it must fail and we log `escrow_late_apply_attempts`.

Tess: Good. Also ensure proto: escrow responses include trace/span with policy and resident-region for easy tracing. Add header X-Escrow-Id in response.

Harper: Small load test script (staging):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 2000); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \
       -H "X-Policy: lease-escrow-probe-v1" \
       -d '{"tenant":"t-7001","op":"write-probe","payload":"..."}' \
       https://api.staging.redwood/v1/ops &
done
wait
```

Dmitri: ops-bot scheduled canary: proxy/lease-escrow-probe-v1 -> canary-99. Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/99

consent-bot: Note: EU tenants must include consent_verifier = sha256(consent_token|tenant_id). We'll mark any missing as noncompliant.

Ibrahim: If reconciler shows systemic mismatches, follow-up action is to open an RFC for adjusting routing contracts and escrow semantics (e.g., change token expiry or include additional metadata).

Harper: One more: ensure reconciler runs under a service principal with minimal perms and cannot promote escrow tokens to real commits. Add guard tests asserting no commit path exists in sandbox.

Dmitri: I'll own the canary run and post metrics. If green after 4h at 1% we can ramp to 5% for 12h. Any objections?

Tess: No objections. Let's proceed. Please post PR and dashboard link here. :white_check_mark:
